tasks.description: Первый серверный фундамент T162/T019/T044: production plant.create из каталога и sync через существующие SQL RPC. Без UI, полного T162, guest claim, deploy и объявления live-приёмки.
constraints: Only write_files. No migrations, tools/config/handoff/tasks changes, deployment, credentials in code/logs, real network or live integration. Read constitution/spec. Preserve other endpoints and explicit dependency injection safety tests. Ordinary unified diff only.

Build a small collection.ts RPC adapter and HTTP handlers, production factory wiring used explicitly in Deno.serve. Keep createPlantsApiHandler() without explicit dependencies safe/unavailable so existing T152 safety fixtures stay meaningful. Production factory actually supplies command/sync handlers with server-only service role client; lazily validate SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; missing config fails 503, never fake success. Dependency injection supports mocked RPC/fetch for fixture tests, production uses actual Supabase RPC. No new generic service framework.

Authenticated identity is authoritative: never accept owner_id from body/query. Fix defaultResolveRequestContext fail-open on missing/error profile; require actual active profile, no fallback active. Test invalid token, missing/error/deleting/deleted profile and anonymous create forbidden before privileged RPC. Catalogue plant.create only permanent owner; sync follows active owner contract. No client service role credentials.

Use canonical current Swift envelope operation_id/command_name/payload_json (JSON object encoded as string) and document precisely. Require valid UUID and matching X-Operation-Id if supplied, object payload with catalogue creation_source only; reject owner injection and unsupported/retired commands before RPC. Do not enable draft/guest fallback, rooms, new camera_estimate/season inputs. Do not require photo or care questionnaire for catalogue create. Respect existing catalogue SQL fields and pass payload unchanged after validation; no client-side payload hash or operation receipts fabrication.

Call execute_plant_create_command(p_owner_id,p_operation_id,p_payload) and fetch_sync_delta with authoritative context owner and validated since/until/complete cursor/limit 1..500. Read actual latest SQL projection and preserve its canonical receipt/sync shape losslessly; do not guess Swift compatibility. Document canonical response and outstanding client DTO adaptation explicitly. Replay uses same operation/payload SQL result; uniqueness/payload conflicts map 409. No adapter-generated fake replay flag/plant/watermark. Null/unexpected RPC results must fail, not synthesize empty success.

Map COLLECTION_LIMIT_REACHED to explicit HTTP409 COLLECTION_LIMIT_REACHED nonretryable, separate from analysis quota; auth/owner boundaries 401/403; validation 400, operation mismatch 409, transient RPC failures 503 retryable. Never expose SQL internals/service credentials/raw errors to clients. EN/PL error messages. Preserve SQL authoritative cap/retry/history semantics.

Create meaningful collection_http_test.ts covering production factory wiring with mocked transport (not only direct handlers), canonical RPC request args, exact returned real fixture data, successful create and same retry, cap/error mapping, null/error results, owner spoofing denied, invalid UUID/JSON/unknown command/header mismatch, sync pagination/cursor/tombstones/watermarks, invalid query no RPC, A/B context isolation and auth/profile guards. No skipped tests. Reviewer must examine actual assertions and production wiring; fake SQL RPC fixtures do not prove live DB or positive guest claim. Existing cap SQL gate separately regression checks unchanged SQL.

Full T162/T019/T044/T149 stay open: no client save UI or live acceptance in this slice. collection-http.md records canonical request/response, limitations and client next step without changing old contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production command/sync factory uses real server RPC and fails closed on auth/config/owner errors; canonical create/retry/cap/conflict and sync projections verified by meaningful HTTP fixtures including production composition. No fabricated success or SQL detail leaks.
Unchanged SQL collection cap/history/retry/concurrency regression gate passes in isolated PostgreSQL; no migrations modified, no live or guest acceptance claimed.
Deno entrypoint typecheck and whitespace pass; canonical HTTP contract documented and client/live limitations explicit.
